newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Jan tax revenue amounts to 10.10 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russian Jan tax revenue amounts to 10.10 bln rbls.

text.p: Russia's State Tax Service collected 10.10 trillion roubles in taxes in January, well over the 8.00 trillion rouble target for the month, Itar-Tass news agency said on Monday, quoting a tax service official.
December tax revenues amounted to 45 trillion roubles.
The International Monetary Fund board approved on Friday the disbursement of an overdue $650 million from its $10 billion loan to Russia.
The tranches had been delayed because the fund was worried about poor tax revenues.
Tax collection for the period between February 1 and 5 amounted to 816 billion roubles, or eight billion roubles more than in the same period of 1996, Itar-Tass said.
